Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning electrical work that requires minimal electrical circuit modifications and has limited exposure hazards.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to modifying electrical permitting and inspectionrequirements applicable to work that requires minimal electricalcircuit modifications and has limited exposure hazards; and creating anew section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that some electricalwork requires minimal electrical circuit modifications and has limitedexposure hazards. The legislature also finds that it may beappropriate to permit and inspect such work on a random basis, or toexempt such work from permitting and inspection requirements. Anychanges to current law, however, should further the state's compellingpublic interest in protecting public safety.
